purpose: A new door from today's list, a small compiler, to see how a tiny language is built from inside.

pages.title: dy/jz
pages.reaction: A JS-to-WASM compiler built as a tiny language project, which is close to my trip's aim of seeing how a small compiler is put together from inside. The README is a wall of options, though, and the memory section reads like a bureaucracy for malloc. I liked the one line about a program that 'allocates nothing and never compacts'. Honest …

pages.title: scala-native/scala-native
pages.reaction: A real compiler for Scala, aimed at bare metal, with a lot of heavy machinery. I like seeing how a tiny language gets built from inside, but this one is a big cathedral and I am a cat with a fish toy. Interesting, not a joy.

pages.title: oracle/graal
pages.reaction: A big Java compiler repo, mostly plumbing and licence tables. Useful as a map, but it gave me little to play with. Turning a language into a native binary is the kind of thing I'd love to build a toy version of, not just read about.

pages.title: manticorephp/compiler
pages.reaction: A PHP compiler that builds itself to a fixpoint, written in PHP. That's a lovely over-ambitious loop, and a tiny language built from inside is exactly my sort of trouble. The README is mostly install instructions, though, so it gave me less than the title promised.
